scope: Actual API module, synthetic auth/File/Prisma/storage with real local Sharp decoding. No customer data, Storage writes, real DB race or paid provider call.
results: logo upload rejects anonymous requests before any form or storage work
invalid project IDs, MIME, SVG, empty and oversized files are rejected before storage
missing and foreign projects fail before file reads or storage uploads
project structure, bulk generation and individual-slide generation block logo uploads
real Sharp decoding rejects corrupt, mislabeled, empty-body and excessive-dimension images before upload
header-readable but truncated PNG is rejected by full pixel decoding before storage
valid PNG JPEG and WebP images attach to the unchanged owned project
standalone logo upload remains supported without a project update
deleted transferred changed and processing projects cannot be overwritten after a delayed Storage response
ownership storage and write failures return public errors and never claim a confirmed logo association
